intro: Cookiebot (by Usercentrics) works by scanning your site for cookies and auto-blocking scripts. Configuration is done in the Cookiebot Manager at manage.cookiebot.com. After making changes, trigger a new cookie scan from the dashboard and re-embed the updated script on your site.

sections.title: Classify unrecognised cookies
steps: Log in to manage.cookiebot.com and open your domain.
Go to the Cookie tab. Any cookies marked as 'Unclassified' correspond to cookies flagged as REVIEW in this report.

For each unclassified cookie, review the purpose and assign the correct category (Necessary, Preferences, Statistics, or Marketing). Do not leave revenue-generating or analytics cookies as Necessary unless they genuinely are.

sections.title: Enable auto-blocking for non-essential scripts
steps: In the Cookiebot Manager, go to Settings → Auto-blocking.
Ensure auto-blocking is enabled. Cookiebot will rewrite script tags on your page to prevent them firing until the relevant consent category is accepted.
If you use Google Tag Manager, add Cookiebot's GTM template from the Community Template Gallery, or manually add consent checks to each tag using Cookiebot's dataLayer events.
Verify auto-blocking is working: visit your site in a fresh private window and check that Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, and similar tags do not appear in the Network tab before you click 'Allow'.

sections.title: Confirm the banner shows Reject on the first layer
steps: In the Cookiebot Manager, go to Dialog and review the button configuration.
Ensure a 'Decline' or 'Reject' button is visible on the first-layer banner with equal prominence to 'Allow cookies'.
If your banner only shows 'Allow cookies' and 'Customise', this creates an asymmetry that may not meet ICO guidance. Add a direct decline option.
